authority.alpha_prerequisite: Implement and prove the researched segment-v6 adaptive LZ4 page codec inside the sole rrflowKV persistence boundary so flush, compaction, reopen, snapshot, bounded reads, and future DataFusion source batches share authenticated physical semantics.

current_behavior: The clean baseline accepts only segment v5. It persists six authenticated Arrow-layout buffers and canonical row-group filters, but every page is raw and physical length must equal logical length. Compression policy is not configurable, bytes_decompressed remains zero, and current fixtures, fuzzing, traces, and source-of-truth records describe v5.
target_behavior: Directly replace segment v5 with authenticated segment v6. Add validated none and adaptive-LZ4 writer policies, deterministic per-page selection, stored-byte digests, a one-GiB reconstructed logical envelope, checksum-before-decode, exact aligned bounded decode, truthful ownership/cache/query/open evidence, flush and compaction propagation, none-versus-adaptive semantic differential proof, current-format fixtures and fuzzing, and one clean-revision integration artifact. Do not introduce a second persistence authority or change query semantics.
unchanged_behavior: WAL, MVCC visibility, manifest-v3 publication, snapshot-bundle-v1 envelope, transaction authority, row-group filtering, projected-read ordering, tombstone behavior, crash boundaries, and garbage-collection ownership remain unchanged.
rrflowQL and DataFusion remain downstream stamped compute over bounded Arrow-compatible batches; they do not own persistence, authentication, decompression, or cache admission in this package.
Zstandard remains laboratory-only; Moka, value separation, family grouping, graph, BM25, ANN, TurboQuant, installation, attunement, SDK, Connectome, and binary release work remain separately gated.
Segment versions one through five are rejection inputs only; no compatibility reader, migration shim, fallback, or positive v5 fixture is retained.
Product version remains 1.0.0, C-06 and POAM-002 remain open, and only rrflow/rrflow-development may receive this pre-release package.
